explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration that states this result. The theorem says that the solvable-radical defining ideal is invariant under isomorphisms of finite-type commutative Hopf algebras. All of its main notions are the library's own definitions: `solvableRadicalDefiningIdeal`, `HopfIdeal.comapOfSurjective`, `IsSolvableRadicalCandidate` and `FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat`. Mathlib has no Hopf ideals, and no solvable radical of an algebraic group defined through Hopf algebras, so it cannot contain this statement. The proof itself only uses library lemmas, together with general category-theory facts (`ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso`, `hom_inv_id`) and `le_antisymm`.
